GEN_BOUNDED.on_exhaustion: UNSAT_WITH_RULE_EVIDENCE or TIMEOUT_UNCLASSIFIED; never automatic PASS or unsupported fallback

REFERENCE_BOUNDED.bound_required_before_run: Actual CFG/loops/dot terms and model cost must be resolved; increase budget explicitly if a required witness exceeds it.
REFERENCE_BOUNDED.on_exhaustion: Collect last semantic event, wait graph and model/schedule inputs; classify before assigning functional FAIL/PASS.

SM_PROGRESS.required_resolution: Per-recipe admitted work bound plus approved backend/service latency/fairness; numeric cycle thresholds unresolved => BLOCKED.
SM_PROGRESS.on_exhaustion: Flush waveform/event/wait graph and classify DUT stall vs external starvation vs unclassified timeout; wall time is a harness budget, not ISA latency.

SOC_PROGRESS.required_resolution: Cross-SM/remote service/transport contracts, failure-report and cancel/drain bounds; unresolved => BLOCKED.
SOC_PROGRESS.on_exhaustion: Preserve endpoint/owner/phase/tx-unit and remote side-effect evidence. Do not blindly retry non-idempotent operations.

workload_policy.pressure: Case-defined legal admitted-capacity/allowed-order/backpressure variants only; missing stress recipe blocks this run.

pressure_by_phase.P1_GENERATOR_UNIT: Bounded largest approved candidate/constraint/attempt workload; only generator-side evidence.
pressure_by_phase.P2_REFERENCE_PROGRAM: Bounded model interleavings and ledger/merge work; no DUT coverage.
pressure_by_phase.P3_SM_RTL: Legal admitted resource/return pressure and completion escape paths in the approved recipe.
pressure_by_phase.P4_SOC: Legal multi-endpoint traffic, delayed remote returns and defined faults under explicit service assumptions.

wrapper_steps: 完成本case原始phase操作，物化输入、初始化、schedule、seed、版本及对应接受/拒绝/模型或实际结果证据。
恢复独立初态并用同一immutable manifest调用同一phase回放接口，不重新抽样或派生seed；未获准的候选不得送DUT。
比较刺激hash、审计分类及case定义的oracle关系；只有确定单例输出强制逐值一致，保故障回放须匹配原signature。
保留原始和回放证据及差异/不稳定分类，不把第二次成功覆盖第一次失败。
